item.title: 'Bats Would Like a Word': PETA Slammed for Praising OZZY OSBOURNE’s Animal Activism After His Death at 76
item.description: After Ozzy Osbourne’s death at age 76, tributes came pouring in from around the world. Fans, musicians, and public figures honored the legendary frontman of Black Sabbath. But one tribute in particular sparked confusion and criticism: a memorial from People for the Ethical Treatment of Animals (PETA).

item.title: OZZY OSBOURNE’s Sister Shares the Last Text Message From the Rock Legend Before His Death at 76
item.description: Ozzy Osbourne’s sister has spoken out about the emotional final message she received from her brother just before his death at age 76. Jean Powell, 85, revealed that the Black Sabbath frontman sent her a touching text on the night of his last concert, only weeks before he passed away.

item.title: How OZZY OSBOURNE Would Like to Be Remembered, According to His Own Words
item.description: Ozzy Osbourne, the voice behind Black Sabbath and a pillar of heavy metal history, died on Tuesday, July 22, at age 76. Fans around the world are mourning the loss of the man who helped define the genre with a mix of raw energy, chaos, and oddly enough, heartfelt honesty.

item.title: TONY IOMMI Says OZZY OSBOURNE Pushed Through Final Show: 'He Didn't Look Well'
item.description: In his first public comments since Ozzy Osbourne’s death, Tony Iommi told ITV News the loss caught him off guard. Even though Ozzy’s health had clearly declined in recent months, Iommi didn’t expect things to end so soon (transcribed by LOUDLEGENDS.

item.title: First Details Emerge of Ozzy Osbourne’s Death: Air Ambulance Arrived at Country Estate as Medics Tried to Save His Life
item.description: Emergency responders were dispatched to Ozzy Osbourne’s countryside home in Buckinghamshire, England, on Tuesday morning as efforts were made to save the 76-year-old rock legend. A Thames Valley Air Ambulance helicopter landed on a nearby field close to Osbourne’s estate, Welders House, around 10:30 a.

item.title: Friends Worried About SHARON OSBOURNE’s Health After OZZY’s Death: 'She's Not Doing Well'
item.description: Close friends of Sharon Osbourne are raising alarms about her well-being following the recent death of her husband, Ozzy Osbourne, who passed away at 76. A report from the Daily Mail quoted sources close to the 72-year-old, who say she is physically frail and emotionally overwhelmed.

item.title: COLDPLAY Honors OZZY OSBOURNE With Emotional Cover of 'Changes'; VIDEO
item.description: Coldplay paused their regular setlist on July 22 to pay tribute to one of heavy metal’s most iconic figures, Ozzy Osbourne, just hours after news broke of his death at age 76.

item.title: Jake E. Lee Shares the Final Text Meessage He Got From Ozzy Osbourne Before His Death
item.description: Jake E. Lee, former guitarist for Ozzy Osbourne, has shared the final message he received from his old bandmate shortly before Osbourne’s death at 76. The two briefly reconnected during Back to the Beginning, the farewell show for Black Sabbath, held at Villa Park in Birmingham.

item.title: Iron Maiden Breaks Silence On Ozzy Osbourne Passing After Fan Backlash
item.description: Iron Maiden has finally addressed the death of Ozzy Osbourne after fans criticized the band for staying silent. In a statement posted Wednesday (July 23), the British metal group offered condolences to Sharon Osbourne and the rest of Ozzy’s family, while acknowledging his role in shaping the genre.

item.title: The Chilling Thing OZZY OSBOURNE Said In 2023 That Predicted His Own Death
item.description: Ozzy Osbourne, the legendary frontman of Black Sabbath, died on July 22, 2025, at age 76. The world lost one of rock’s most iconic voices, but some fans are still thinking about what he said two years earlier that now feels like an eerie prediction.

item.title: The Final Wish OZZY OSBOURNE Made Before He Died; And How His Family Helped Make It Happen
item.description: Ozzy Osbourne spent his last days in the English countryside, just as he had hoped. The rock legend, who passed away at 76, died at his estate in Buckinghamshire, surrounded by his wife Sharon Osbourne and their children Jack, Kelly, Aimee, and Louis.

item.title: Iron Maiden Faces Backlash Over Silence on Ozzy Osbourne’s Death
item.description: Iron Maiden is catching heat online after failing to publicly acknowledge the death of Ozzy Osbourne, who passed away on July 22, 2025, at the age of 76.

item.title: Artists Pay Tribute To Ozzy Osbourne Across Social Media Following His Passing At 76
item.description: The music world is mourning the death of Ozzy Osbourne, who passed away at 76. Friends, fellow artists, and fans have taken to social media to share memories, offer condolences, and reflect on his enormous impact on music, especially heavy metal.

item.title: Ozzy Osbourne’s Final Years Were Marked by Parkinson’s, Falls, and Health Complications From Past Accidents
item.description: Ozzy Osbourne had been open about his declining health for years. Before his death at 76, the legendary singer faced a series of medical setbacks, including a diagnosis of Parkinson’s disease, spinal injuries from past accidents, and multiple surgeries.

item.title: Ozzy Osbourne, Black Sabbath Icon And Heavy Metal Pioneer, Dies At 76
item.description: Ozzy Osbourne, one of the most recognizable voices in rock and heavy metal, has died at the age of 76. The Osbourne family confirmed the news on July 22, 2025, saying he passed peacefully at home, surrounded by loved ones.

item.title: MEGADETH’s DAVE MUSTAINE Reached Out to Join OZZY OSBOURNE and BLACK SABBATH’s 'Back To The Beginning' Final Show, But 'Nothing Came of It', Says LOMENZO
item.description: Megadeth bassist James LoMenzo says the band was not invited to perform at “Back To The Beginning”, the high-profile charity concert that celebrated Black Sabbath’s final show. The event took place in Birmingham, UK on July 5.

item.title: SOUNDGARDEN Finally Addresses Absence From Ozzy Osbourne and Black Sabbath Farewell Concert
item.description: Soundgarden was noticeably absent from Back to the Beginning, the farewell show for Ozzy Osbourne and Black Sabbath, held on July 5th in Birmingham, England. The concert brought together many of the biggest names in rock and metal, including Metallica, Guns N’ Roses, Tool, and Mastodon.

item.title: KELLY OSBOURNE Doesn’t Hold Back After Bizarre VIRAL AI Video Claims OZZY and SHARON Made a Private End-of-Life Decision
item.description: Kelly Osbourne is setting the record straight about her parents, Ozzy and Sharon Osbourne. The TV personality and daughter of the legendary rocker addressed growing rumors on social media suggesting that her parents had entered a so-called “suicide pact” to end their lives together if their health deteriorated.

item.title: HALESTORM Drops New Song 'RAIN YOUR BLOOD ON ME' From Upcoming Album 'EVEREST'
item.description: Halestorm has released a new single titled “Rain Your Blood On Me,” giving fans another preview of the band’s next studio album, Everest, due out August 8 through Atlantic Records (listen below).

item.title: Ghost's TOBIAS FORGE Says He Wanted to Perform a Different Song at BLACK SABBATH’s Farewell Show: 'No! Already Taken'
item.description: Tobias Forge, the voice behind Ghost, recently shared that his first pick for Black Sabbath’s farewell show didn’t make the cut. The singer was one of many artists invited to perform at Back to the Beginning, a massive farewell event for Black Sabbath and Ozzy Osbourne.

item.title: TONY IOMMI Reveals the BLACK SABBATH Songs That Were Rehearsed but Cut From the Final 'BACK TO THE BEGINNING' Setlist
item.description: Tony Iommi says Black Sabbath had a longer setlist in mind for their recent reunion show, but time and circumstances forced them to cut it short. During a new interview with Eddie Trunk on SiriusXM’s Trunk Nation (transcribed by BLABBERMOUTH.

item.title: TOM MORELLO Reveals How Much OZZY OSBOURNE’s Final Concert with BLACK SABBATH Raised for Parkinson’s and Children’s Charities
item.description: Ozzy Osbourne has taken his final bow with Black Sabbath, and the farewell concert didn’t just mark the end of an era in heavy metal, it also made a major impact for charity.

item.title: Watch LIMP BIZKIT’s FRED DURST Honor OZZY OSBOURNE And BLACK SABBATH With An Acoustic Cover Of 'CHANGES'
item.description: Limp Bizkit’s frontman Fred Durst delivered a surprising and heartfelt performance during the Back to the Beginning tribute to Ozzy Osbourne and Black Sabbath, even though he didn’t attend in person.

item.title: JACK BLACK Covers 'MR. CROWLEY' with Young Rock Musicians in Tribute to OZZY OSBOURNE; VIDEO
item.description: Jack Black paid tribute to Ozzy Osbourne with a dramatic performance of “Mr. Crowley”, recorded on video and played during the Back to the Beginning event in Birmingham, England, on Saturday, July 5.

item.title: OZZY OSBOURNE Receives 'Unbelievable' Emotional Gift From YUNGBLUD Before Final BLACK SABBATH Performance in Birmingham; VIDEO
item.description: As Ozzy Osbourne prepared to take the stage one last time with Black Sabbath, another artist was waiting backstage with something a bit unexpected. Yungblud, the genre-bending musician from Doncaster, brought more than just his performance to Villa Park in Birmingham.

item.title: Fans Slam MARILYN MANSON's Tribute at BLACK SABBATH Farewell: 'Disgraceful' Appearance Sparks Backlash
item.description: Marilyn Manson’s surprise appearance, albeit virtual, during Black Sabbath’s farewell concert on July 5 has sparked a wave of criticism from fans online and at the venue.

item.title: Did BLACK SABBATH Walk Off Stage And Leave OZZY OSBOURNE Alone? Here's What Really Happened At The End Of The Farewell Show; VIDEO
item.description: Black Sabbath played their final concert on July 5 at Villa Park in Birmingham, England. It was a historic night, the last time all four original members, Ozzy Osbourne, Tony Iommi, Geezer Butler, and Bill Ward, would share a stage.

item.title: SHARON OSBOURNE Teased A Post-Show Reveal About The Band She Banned From OZZY's Farewell, But We Might Already Know Who It Is
item.description: For a concert billed as Back to the Beginning, meant to close the book on the legacy of Black Sabbath and mark Ozzy Osbourne’s final bow, one detail stood out more for what was missing than what was onstage.

item.title: The Words JAMES HETFIELD Waited Decades To Say Onstage To BLACK SABBATH At Their Final Show
item.description: Metallica showed up in full force at Back to the Beginning, a farewell event held on July 5 at Villa Park in Birmingham, England. The show was designed to mark the final chapter for Black Sabbath as a live band, as well as the last-ever solo performance by Ozzy Osbourne.

item.title: SHARON OSBOURNE Confirms OZZY's Touring Days Are Over: 'He's Done. We're Going Home And Shutting The Door'
item.description: Ozzy Osbourne’s long career on stage has officially come to a close. His final live performance took place on Saturday, July 5, during Back to the Beginning, a special concert event in Birmingham, the hometown of Black Sabbath.

item.title: Disturbed's DAVID DRAIMAN On Crowd Reaction At Sabbath Farewell: 'A Few Jew Hating Morons'
item.description: Disturbed frontman David Draiman took the stage at Black Sabbath’s Back to the Beginning farewell event on July 5, held at Villa Park in Birmingham. What should have been a tribute moment turned into a noisy reception for the singer, who was booed by parts of the crowd before performing “Shot in the Dark” and “Sweet Leaf” as part of a rotating supergroup lineup.

item.title: Godsmack's SULLY ERNA Pays Tribute to OZZY OSBOURNE: 'Another Childhood Hero Has Taken His Final Bow'
item.description: Godsmack singer Sully Erna has shared a heartfelt message honoring Ozzy Osbourne, following the rock icon’s final show in Birmingham, England. The “Back to the Beginning” concert on July 5 marked the end of an era, as Ozzy performed one last time for over 40,000 fans at Villa Park.

item.title: DISTURBED's DAVID DRAIMAN Booed by Some Fans at BLACK SABBATH's Final Show; VIDEO
item.description: Disturbed’s frontman David Draiman stepped onto the stage at Back to the Beginning, the all-star farewell concert for Ozzy Osbourne and Black Sabbath, and was met with a crowd that didn’t quite know how to respond (watch below).

item.title: KELLY OSBOURNE and SID WILSON Get Engaged at OZZY OSBOURNE’s Final BLACK SABBATH Concert; VIDEO
item.description: Kelly Osbourne and Sid Wilson are officially engaged. The couple marked the occasion in a memorable way, with the proposal happening backstage at none other than Ozzy Osbourne’s final concert with Black Sabbath.

item.title: The Songs METALLICA Chose to Say 'Thank You' to BLACK SABBATH in Front of 40,000+ Fans
item.description: Metallica showed up loud, fast, and full of gratitude at Black Sabbath’s final concert, delivering a powerful six-song set that included two unexpected tributes to the band that helped create heavy metal.

item.title: Watch OZZY OSBOURNE and BLACK SABBATH Reunite for Final Performance at 'Back to the Beginning' in Birmingham
item.description: Ozzy Osbourne gave his final live performance on Saturday, July 5, during the Back to the Beginning event at Villa Park in Birmingham, U.K. The 76-year-old singer took the stage seated on a black throne, delivering a five-song set with his solo band.

item.title: The Demos BLACK SABBATH Recorded Before They Were Famous Are Finally Coming Out
item.description: Before the world knew them as Black Sabbath, the band that helped define heavy metal was just four young musicians from Birmingham, England, playing under the name Earth.

item.title: Spinal Tap Director ROB REINER Calls BLACK SABBATH 'Dumb' Over Stonehenge Accusation: 'It’s Ridiculous'
item.description: The director behind This Is Spinal Tap is calling out Black Sabbath for something that happened over 40 years ago, and he’s not pulling any punches. In a recent interview with Screen Rant, filmmaker Rob Reiner revisited a long-standing misunderstanding between the legendary heavy metal band and the makers of the cult comedy film.

item.title: SHARON OSBOURNE Says When She'll Reveal Which Band Was Cut From BLACK SABBATH's Final Show: 'People Will Be Shocked'
item.description: As Black Sabbath prepares to take the stage for the last time at Villa Park, the band’s farewell concert is already generating headlines. This time, it’s not the music or the massive lineup drawing attention.

item.title: TONY IOMMI Reveals How Many Songs OZZY OSBOURNE Will Sing at BLACK SABBATH's Final Concert: 'He Can’t Do the Whole Show'
item.description: Black Sabbath is getting ready to take the stage one last time. The band’s final performance, set for Saturday, July 5, will take place in their hometown of Birmingham, England.

item.title: SLIPKNOT’s COREY TAYLOR Explains Why He Keeps Returning to a 1970 BLACK SABBATH Track That Still Terrifies Him
item.description: Slipknot frontman Corey Taylor still remembers the chill he got the first time he heard Black Sabbath, the song, not just the band. In a recent interview with the BBC, Taylor shared how deeply the track affected him.

item.title: OZZY OSBOURNE Confirms Live Retirement: 'It’s A Goodbye As Far As My Live Performances Go'
item.description: In a new interview promoting this weekend’s Back to the Beginning event, the legendary Black Sabbath frontman confirmed that his upcoming concert at Villa Park in Birmingham, England, will be his final time performing live.

item.title: OZZY OSBOURNE Launches Limited Makeup Line With Jolie Beauty
item.description: The rock legend has partnered with Jolie Beauty, an independent makeup brand based in Birmingham, U.K., to create a limited-edition collection of cosmetics. The collection will go on sale starting July 9 through the Jolie Beauty website.

item.title: BLACK SABBATH’s Founding Four Reunite Ahead of OZZY OSBOURNE’s Final Show; First Photos Released
item.description: The original members of Black Sabbath have reunited to rehearse for one last performance. Ozzy Osbourne, Geezer Butler, Tony Iommi, and Bill Ward are preparing for their farewell event, “Back To The Beginning: Ozzy’s Final Bow”, which takes place on July 5 at Villa Park in Birmingham, England.

item.title: FAITH NO MORE’s Mike Bordin Says OZZY OSBOURNE Saved His Life: 'You’re the reason I’m here'
item.description: When Faith No More released The Real Thing in June 1989, it marked more than just their third studio album. It was the first with vocalist Mike Patton and quickly became a defining moment for the band.

item.title: Why One of OZZY OSBOURNE’s Old Rivals Agreed to Play at BLACK SABBATH’s Farewell Show
item.description: Jake E. Lee hasn’t spoken to Ozzy Osbourne in decades. The two didn’t exactly part ways on good terms, and there’s been little reason for contact since Lee was fired back in the ’80s.

item.title: WOLFGANG VAN HALEN Explains Why He Backed Out of OZZY OSBOURNE’s Final Concert: 'I Wouldn’t Be Able To Pull It Off'
item.description: Wolfgang Van Halen, son of late guitar legend Eddie Van Halen, was originally scheduled to appear at Ozzy Osbourne’s farewell concert, Back to the Beginning, on July 5 in Birmingham, U.

item.title: The Guitarist TOM MORELLO Fought To Bring Back For Black Sabbath’s Last Show: 'I Can’t Imagine This Happening Without You'
item.description: Tom Morello is playing a key role in organizing Black Sabbath’s last concert. And for him, one name was essential: Jake E. Lee, the guitarist who played with Ozzy Osbourne in the 1980s.

item.title: The Band EDDIE VAN HALEN Believed Saved Rock ‘n’ Roll From Extinction: 'Rock Wouldn’t Exist Without Them'
item.description: Rock music has had plenty of supposed saviors. Every few decades, someone new gets the credit for dragging the genre back from the brink. Eddie Van Halen was one of those names, but according to him, his own rise might not have happened without a much earlier band shaking things up.

item.title: OZZY OSBOURNE Honored With New 'Working Class Hero' Display in Hometown
item.description: A new exhibition honoring Ozzy Osbourne is now open in his hometown of Birmingham, England. The “Working Class Hero” exhibit launched Wednesday (June 25) at the Birmingham Museum & Art Gallery.

item.title: The BLACK SABBATH Song That Blew Led Zeppelin's JOHN BONHAM’s Mind
item.description: Before joining Led Zeppelin and becoming a rock legend, John Bonham was already turning heads in the music scene of England’s Black Country. As a teenager, just 16 years old, he crossed paths with a fellow drummer: Bill Ward, who would later power Black Sabbath’s thunderous rhythm section.

item.title: SHARON OSBOURNE Talks OZZY’s Farewell Show: 'He Didn't Get To Say Goodbye'
item.description: Black Sabbath is officially preparing for its final show with original singer Ozzy Osbourne. The band shared a new photo of Ozzy, bassist Geezer Butler, and drummer Bill Ward in a rehearsal studio (See the photo at the end of the article).

item.title: JAKE E. LEE Asks Fans Not To Judge OZZY OSBOURNE’s Performance: 'He Deserves This Farewell'
item.description: Guitarist Jake E. Lee is urging fans to show compassion ahead of Back to the Beginning, the farewell concert for Ozzy Osbourne and the original Black Sabbath lineup.

item.title: CHARLIE BENANTE Says BLACK SABBATH Helped Shape ANTHRAX’s Sound: 'We Covered Sabbath Bloody Sabbath'
item.description: Anthrax drummer Charlie Benante pointed to Black Sabbath as a key influence on the band’s formative sound, recalling how their admiration for the Birmingham pioneers led them to cover Sabbath Bloody Sabbath during a formative period in their career.

item.title: SHARON OSBOURNE Talks About IRON MAIDEN Drama: 'It’s Just The Singer I Can’t Stand'
item.description: Sharon Osbourne still hasn’t let it go. Two decades after the absolute circus that was Ozzfest 2005, she’s perfectly willing to laugh about sabotaging Iron Maiden with beans, pre-recorded sound effects, and strategic sound cuts.

item.title: BLACK SABBATH's Tony Iommi Talks About Final Show Concerns: 'The Unknown Worries Me'
item.description: Tony Iommi, the ever-present architect of Black Sabbath, isn’t exactly sleeping easy as the band’s farewell inches closer. Set for July 5 in Birmingham, England, the hometown gig isn’t just another concert.

item.title: How LEMMY KILMISTER Helped Invent THRASH METAL With ACE OF SPADES
item.description: By the late 1970s, rock had ballooned into a spectacle of arena shows, towering stage sets, and endless guitar acrobatics. Meanwhile tucked away in sweaty basements and smoky pubs, a small group of musicians were chasing something far less polished.

item.title: DUFF MCKAGAN Compares OZZY OSBOURNE to Lemmy, Prince, and Iggy Pop
item.description: Duff McKagan has seen plenty of rock stars come and go, but when it comes to Ozzy Osbourne, he doesn’t mince words. “A constant in rock and roll,” as he puts it.

item.title: Ozzy Osbourne “Can’t Walk,” But His Legendary Voice Remains Untouched, Says Sharon
item.description: Alright, so Ozzy Osbourne—THE Prince of Darkness—is out here casually defying medical science. The dude CANNOT WALK. But he CAN STILL BELT OUT “CRAZY TRAIN” LIKE IT’S 1980.

item.title: The End of an Era: Ozzy Osbourne’s Final Performance with Black Sabbath Announced
item.description: You ever notice how bands never actually retire? They announce their very last, totally final, we swear on our drummer’s snare collection concert… and then five years later—boom.
